title_en: Song Zhi'an v. Wuxi Boiler Factory No. 1 Branch — dispute over patent infringement

full_text_en:
Song Zhi'an v. Wuxi Boiler Factory No.1 Branch — dispute over patent infringement

Plaintiff: Song Zhi'an, male, 44 years old, General Manager of Shandong Zhangqiu Shenghuo Technology Co., Ltd.

Agent ad litem: Mao Yixing, lawyer of Zhenjiang Kunlun Law Office, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Wuxi Boiler Factory No.1 Branch, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Huang Rengao, Factory Director.

Agent ad litem: Huang Shihao, Office Director of Wuxi Boiler Factory No.1 Branch, Jiangsu Province.

Agent ad litem: Sun Zimei, lawyer of Wuxi Hengfeng Law Office, Jiangsu Province.

Third Party: Beijing General Energy Power Company.

Legal Representative: Jin Jian, General Manager.

Agent ad litem: Cao Junbin, Deputy Director of Boiler Engineering Department, Beijing General Energy Power Company.

On August 6, 1993, the plaintiff Song Zhi'an filed a utility model patent application for "Layered Boiler Coal Feeding Device." The Chinese Patent Office granted the patent on May 8, 1994, with patent number 93231575.5, and published it on July 3 of the same year. Subsequently, Song Zhi'an discovered that the defendant Wuxi Boiler Factory No.1 Branch (hereinafter referred to as the Boiler Factory) had started manufacturing products in 1995 that were identical to the patented product, and believed that the Boiler Factory's actions constituted infringement. Therefore, on April 6, 1995, he filed a lawsuit with the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province. After the court accepted the case, because the Boiler Factory filed a request for invalidation of the patent with the Patent Reexamination Board of the Chinese Patent Office, the court ruled to suspend the proceedings. On September 5, 1997, the Patent Reexamination Board of the Chinese Patent Office, after examination, decided to uphold the validity of utility model patent No. 93231575.5. The court resumed the proceedings on November 10 of the same year. During the trial, as the Boiler Factory claimed that the patented technology it used was transferred by Beijing General Energy Power Company (hereinafter referred to as General Company), the court accordingly notified General Company to participate in the proceedings as a third party.

Plaintiff Song Zhi'an alleged that: The defendant, Boiler Factory, without the plaintiff's permission, manufactured and sold products in which the plaintiff held patent rights, causing substantial damage to the plaintiff. The plaintiff requested the court to order the Boiler Factory to immediately cease infringement, eliminate the impact, and apologize, as well as to compensate the plaintiff for economic losses of RMB 400,070, and to bear the litigation costs of this case.

Defendant Boiler Factory argued that: The forward-revolving chain boiler coal feeding device was a product manufactured by our factory after signing a patent licensing agreement with General Company, so it was a lawful use and did not constitute infringement of Song Zhi'an's patent rights.

Third Party General Company stated that: The forward-revolving chain boiler coal feeding device is the third party's patented technology and has nothing to do with the plaintiff's patent rights. Although the defendant Boiler Factory used this technology from the third party through a transfer agreement, the factory did not periodically pay patent royalties to the third party. The third party was not aware of the defendant's production situation or whether there was any infringement of the plaintiff's patented technology. The third party had previously signed a settlement agreement with the plaintiff, mutually agreeing not to pursue matters such as infringement or patent invalidity. The defendant's actions are unrelated to the third party, and the third party should not be held liable for the defendant's actions.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court, upon trial, found that:

The independent claim of patent No. 93231575.5 obtained by plaintiff Song Zhi'an is: A layered boiler coal feeding device, characterized in that it comprises: a housing with an inlet and an outlet; a coal feeding mechanism fixed inside the housing near the inlet; and at least one layer of a sieve fixed near the outlet and forming an angle with the horizontal.

The technical features of the boiler coal feeding device manufactured by the defendant Boiler Factory include: a coal feeding roller, below which is an inclined double-layer comb-type vibrating sieve, above which are juxtaposed a fixed beam-type gate and a sectional swinging box-type gate; one end of the main shaft of the coal feeding roller is provided with a ratchet wheel, and the other end is connected to a power source; the double-layer comb-type vibrating sieve, driven by the ratchet wheel, pawl, and vibration arm, vibrates intermittently around the vibrating sieve's rotating shaft; the sectional swinging box-type gate swings up and down around the pivot pin. The coal feeding roller in this coal feeding device is the coal feeding mechanism described in Song Zhi'an's patent; the double-layer comb-type vibrating sieve is an improvement based on the "sieve" feature in Song Zhi'an's patent; the technical features such as the housing, inlet, and outlet in Song Zhi'an's patent are all present in this coal feeding device. The difference from Song Zhi'an's patent is that this coal feeding device adds ratchet wheel vibration and transmission devices.

On June 16, 1994, the third party General Company filed a utility model patent application for "Forward-Revolving Chain Coal Feeding Device" with the Chinese Patent Office. On March 3, 1995, the Chinese Patent Office granted the patent, and it was published on March 15 of the same year, with patent number ZL94214484.8. On October 10, 1994, to promote this technology, General Company signed a technology transfer agreement with the defendant Boiler Factory, provided the factory with a complete set of technical drawings, and designated the factory as the fixed production plant for the Jiangnan area. The two parties also agreed on their respective rights and interests and the payment of fees. Thereafter, the Boiler Factory manufactured and sold one unit each of 35T boiler coal feeding devices to Wuxi No. 2 Cotton Mill, Wuxi Electrochemical Plant, and Nanjing South City Thermal Power Plant, and paid General Company a technology transfer fee of RMB 100,000 on April 20, 1995, and a patent royalty of RMB 20,000 on April 2, 1996. The technical features of the boiler coal feeding device manufactured by the Boiler Factory were consistent with the technology transferred by General Company.

After Song Zhi'an obtained this patent, on July 26, 1995, he signed a patent implementation license contract with Danyang Boiler Auxiliary Equipment Factory, agreeing to license the factory to implement the layered boiler coal feeding device patent. The royalty was paid in the form of an initial fee plus a royalty fee, with the initial fee being RMB 80,000, and the royalty fee calculated at RMB 20,000 per 35T boiler, RMB 15,000 per 20T boiler, and RMB 10,000 per 10T boiler. Danyang Boiler Auxiliary Equipment Factory has so far paid Song Zhi'an patent royalties of RMB 370,000.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court held that: The scope of protection of a utility model patent shall be determined by the content of its independent claim, and the description and drawings may be used to interpret the claim. Comparing the technical features of the coal feeding device manufactured by the defendant Boiler Factory using the third party General Company's patented technology with the independent claim of the plaintiff Song Zhi'an's patent, except for the addition of new technical features such as the ratchet wheel vibration and transmission device, the other technical features such as components and structural positions are the same as or equivalent to the technical features of Song Zhi'an's patent, completely covering the technical features of that patent and falling within its scope of protection. Although both Song Zhi'an's and General Company's patent applications were granted patent rights, Song Zhi'an's patent application is earlier than General Company's patent application. The former is a basic patent, and the latter is a dependent patent. The implementation of the latter must rely on the patented technology of the former. According to the first-to-file principle stipulated in Article 9 of the Patent Law of the People's Republic of China, when a dependent patentee implements its patent, it must obtain permission from the basic patentee; otherwise, it constitutes infringement. Article 11, paragraph 1 of the Patent Law provides: "After the grant of a patent for invention or utility model, except as otherwise provided by law, no entity or individual may, without the permission of the patentee, manufacture, use, or sell the patented product, or use the patented method, or use or sell the product directly obtained by the patented method for production or business purposes." The coal feeding device manufactured and sold by the Boiler Factory without Song Zhi'an's permission has constituted infringement of Song Zhi'an's patent. According to Article 118 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, Song Zhi'an has the right to request cessation of infringement, elimination of impact, and compensation for losses. With respect to the technology transfer agreement signed between the third party General Company and the Boiler Factory, since the main content of the transferred technology infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of others, that part of the content shall be deemed invalid in accordance with Article 21, paragraph 1, item (3) of the Technology Contract Law of the People's Republic of China regarding the invalidity of technology contracts that infringe upon the lawful rights and interests of others, and the parties shall no longer continue to perform it. The Boiler Factory produced the boiler coal feeding device by signing an agreement and using the technology transferred by General Company, and General Company had already received a technology transfer fee and patent royalties totaling RMB 120,000 under the agreement. General Company has a certain interest in this case, so it should be notified to participate in the proceedings. Although the Boiler Factory did not have the intent to jointly infringe with General Company, it carried out acts that infringed upon Song Zhi'an's patent rights and shall bear partial responsibility. As the transferee, the factory had paid consideration for using this technology in accordance with the agreement, so the other infringement liability in this case shall be borne by General Company. The Boiler Factory's defense that its product technology source was lawful and did not constitute infringement cannot be established. General Company's technology completely covers Song Zhi'an's earlier patent application, so its defense that it has a lawful patent right and does not constitute infringement also cannot be established. As for General Company's claim that it had signed a settlement agreement with Song Zhi'an regarding this patent mutually agreeing not to pursue liability, upon examination, this agreement is not the same fact as this case and cannot exempt General Company from its liability for compensation. The amount of compensation requested by Song Zhi'an was too high, and the excessive portion lacked supporting evidence; therefore, it could only be determined by reference to the patent royalties agreed in the patent implementation license contract he lawfully signed with Danyang Boiler Auxiliary Equipment Factory. Accordingly, on August 12, 1998, the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court rendered judgment:

1. The defendant Boiler Factory shall cease its infringement of the plaintiff Song Zhi'an's patent No. 93231575.5;

2. Within 30 days from the effective date of this judgment, the defendant Boiler Factory shall publish a statement in the *Jiangsu Economic News* apologizing to the plaintiff Song Zhi'an and eliminating the impact (the content must be reviewed by this court); if this is not done within the time limit, this court shall publish the main content of the judgment, and the costs shall be borne by the defendant;

3. The third party General Company shall, within 15 days from the effective date of this judgment, compensate the plaintiff Song Zhi'an for economic losses of RMB 140,000.

Litigation costs of RMB 8,510 shall be borne by the defendant Boiler Factory in the amount of RMB 4,255 and by the third party General Company in the amount of RMB 4,255.

After the first instance judgment was rendered, the third party General Company disagreed and appealed to the Jiangsu High People's Court. The grounds for appeal were: The appellant and Song Zhi'an had previously signed a settlement agreement, and there was no conflict of interest between the appellant and Song Zhi'an. It was wrong for Song Zhi'an to sue the Boiler Factory for infringement and drag the appellant into this case as a third party to bear infringement liability on behalf of the Boiler Factory. If the court found the appellant liable for infringement, the appellant would also file a request for invalidation with the Chinese Patent Reexamination Board, and the court of second instance should suspend the hearing of this case.

The Jiangsu High People's Court, upon trial, held that: The boiler coal feeding device manufactured by the appellee Boiler Factory infringed upon the patent right of the appellee Song Zhi'an, and the Boiler Factory should bear civil liability for cessation of infringement, apology, and compensation for losses. The Boiler Factory implemented the infringing act by signing a patent transfer agreement with the appellant General Company. According to Article 148, paragraph 1 of the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation), which provides that "a person who instigates or assists another person in committing an infringing act is a joint infringer and shall bear joint and several civil liability," General Company should bear joint and several civil liability. Accordingly, in accordance with Article 85 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Jiangsu High People's Court presided over mediation, and on November 19, 1998, the three parties voluntarily reached a mediation agreement under which the Boiler Factory would cease infringement, present a written apology to Song Zhi'an, and compensate Song Zhi'an for economic losses of RMB 110,000, with General Company bearing joint and several civil liability.
